description: This Java class defines a dialog for selecting Android processes or devices for debugging within an IDE environment, utilizing Android Debug Bridge (ADB) and IntelliJ platform APIs.

classes.name: AndroidProcessChooserDialog
classes.description: A dialog class for selecting Android processes or devices for debugging, integrating with Android Debug Bridge and IntelliJ platform APIs.

methods.name: AndroidProcessChooserDialog
methods.description: Constructor initializing the process chooser dialog, setting up UI components, listeners, and updating the process tree.

methods.name: getPreferredFocusedComponent
methods.description: Returns the component that should receive focus when the dialog is shown.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Removes listeners and performs cleanup when the dialog is disposed.

methods.name: updateTree
methods.description: Queues an update to refresh the process/device tree based on current debug sessions.

methods.name: doUpdateTree
methods.description: Builds and sets the process/device tree model based on connected devices and processes.

methods.name: isRelatedProcess
methods.description: Checks if a process description matches known process names.

methods.name: collectAllProcessNames
methods.description: Collects process names from project facets and manifests.

methods.name: collectProcessNames
methods.description: Recursively collects process names from XML attributes.

methods.name: createCenterPanel
methods.description: Returns the main content panel of the dialog.

methods.name: doOKAction
methods.description: Handles the OK action: saves selected device/process, manages existing debug sessions, and initiates new debug session.

methods.name: getDimensionServiceKey
methods.description: Provides a unique key for dialog size persistence.

methods.name: closeOldSessionAndRun
methods.description: Closes existing debug sessions for the selected process and starts a new one.

methods.name: runSession
methods.description: Creates and executes a new debug run configuration.

methods.name: createRunConfiguration
methods.description: Creates a remote debug configuration for the specified port.

methods.name: getRunConfigurationName
methods.description: Generates a name for the debug configuration based on port.

methods.name: getSelectedDevice
methods.description: Retrieves the selected device from the tree.

methods.name: getSelectedClient
methods.description: Retrieves the selected client (process) from the tree.
